rules.statement: A deed conveying an interest in land during the pendency of a partition action is void under section 17 of the Partition Ordinance if it was not obtained after an order of abatement.
rules.supporting_quote: "The failure to take steps to set it aside within a reasonable time gives rise to the inference that the order was well founded and no reason for setting it aside existed. I am content to rest my decision in this case on the ground indicated above, and uphold the title of the plaintiff."
